CARD ABILITY GUIDE

Adventurers, monsters, spells, equipment, environments, and six playable Hybrid Classes.

HOW TO PLAY

Choose your faction on the opening screen. Start with 3 cards; your hand can grow without limit. Each deck contains 20 cards, with at most 4 copies of a card. Drag a card from your hand onto an empty friendly lane. Drag one friendly creature onto another compatible creature to fuse. Equip a creature with one class item, then add a matching second item to discover a hybrid; a completed hybrid locks both items permanently. See the nine recipes under Hybrid Classes in the Card Guide. Drag a Potion onto an injured ally. Drag environments onto the shared environment slot; Dungeon's Darkest Depths grants one random eligible friendly creature +1 permanent ATK at the end of its owner's turn, with no attack bonus cap. Fusion combines all accumulated Dungeon bonuses. Each new environment replaces the previous one for BOTH sides. A coin flip decides the first player. Each player starts with three cards and draws one additional card at the beginning of every turn, including their first turn. If the hand is empty when a turn starts, refill it with three cards instead; an empty hand also refills immediately after playing the last card. Card effects may draw additional cards. Each Action card name can be played once per player turn (for example, only one Supply Run until your next turn); Potions also follow this limit. Looting retrieves only Equipment or Action cards from the discard pile, never Looting itself. The first player cannot attack on the opening turn; afterward newly played creatures can attack immediately. Tap or click a card to select it: the Card Inspector appears above hand cards and below battlefield cards without covering them. Select the active environment card to inspect its ongoing effect. Spiders upgraded by Spider Cocoon show Sturdy in their Card Inspector. Tap the same card again or anywhere outside a card to close the Inspector; tap a different card to replace its description. The selected card is marked SELECTED. For instant action cards, press PLAY SELECTED to use the selected card after inspecting it. Selecting a friendly creature highlights valid targets with pulsing ATTACK and FUSE labels. Click your ready creature and then an enemy card to attack. Click an EMPTY enemy lane in range to attack the opponent's hearts (only if no enemy is within your attack range). You can also click the hearts directly. Click END TURN when ready. On phones, tap a card and then tap its destination if dragging is difficult.

✦ THREE LANES · DECK SELECTION

Choose a game mode and a deck to begin. Works offline for PvE and local PvP. 20 cards per deck · maximum 4 copies of any card · 3 cards to start · unlimited hand size afterward.

❔ HOW TO PLAY ▾

Goal: Reduce your opponent's three hearts to zero. Each player has three lanes and draws cards every turn.

Play: Drag or tap creatures into empty friendly lanes. Equip adventurers with class equipment, play actions, and place an environment in the center. Combine two compatible class items to make a hybrid; both pieces lock permanently once hybridized. All nine recipes are listed in the Card Guide.

Drawing: Both players begin with 3 cards and draw 1 card at the start of every turn, including their first turn. If a player's hand is empty, it immediately refills with 3 cards, including on turn one. At turn start, an empty hand refills with 3 instead of drawing 1. Card effects can draw or search for additional cards.

Attack: Select a ready creature, then choose an enemy in range. If no enemies are in its attack range, attack an empty opposing lane to damage hearts. The first player cannot attack on their opening turn.

Fuse: Fusing removes Webbed from the resulting creature, even if an ingredient was webbed. Drag one compatible friendly creature onto another to create stronger forms. Wolves, Spiders, Goblins, Skeletons and Slimes have fusion paths.

Turns: Play as many cards as you can, then press END TURN. Your hand refills when empty. Choose PvE, local PvP or Online PvP below.
